meta.name: BRPT RPSGT Recommended Reading Master Inventory
meta.purpose: Canonical audit of current BRPT RPSGT exam documents, suggested primary references, named AASM guidance, BRPT-listed textbooks, and high-value Guild additions. Separates BRPT listing, source identity/version, Guild library availability, V3 outline status, and authority role.
meta.statusRule: Never substitute an older library edition, a related title, or a broad society resource for the exact current source identity without an explicit currency boundary.
meta.copyrightBoundary: Store bibliographic metadata, public headings, original summaries, mappings, and lawful locators only. Do not reproduce protected textbook cases/questions, scoring-manual rules, diagnostic criteria, figures, tables, or substantial passages.
